meta.title: nosifit
meta.landingTitle: nosifit — training, nutrition and recovery in one context

hero.title: All your fitness data in one context
hero.lead: Training, nutrition, water, weight and recovery in one place. NosiFit lines them up by day, and recommendations take the whole day into account.
hero.note: Signing up is free. The demo works without an account.

day.label: Sample day
day.aria: Sample day in NosiFit: five signals and the recommendation that follows from them
day.recTitle: Back: 3 sets at RIR 2 instead of 5

context.title: The same workout, a different day
context.text: A workout tracker sees sets. NosiFit also sees the day around them.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.title: One screen for the day
dashboard.text: Workout, food, sleep and habits side by side. Recommendations come from all of them at once.
dashboard.dailyText: Moderate load: a shorter session and more sleep.

training.name: Training
training.title: Volume per muscle, not just a log
training.text: Every set with its own reps and weight. Weekly sets are compared with a target band.

nutrition.name: Nutrition
nutrition.title: Food, water and weight together
nutrition.text: Calories and macros, daily water and the weight trend — no separate apps.
nutrition.chartAria: Weight over 8 weeks: from 80.0 to 78.4 kg

recovery.name: Recovery
recovery.title: Sleep and habits as signals
recovery.text: Sleep, habits and load add up to a recovery score, and you can see what it is made of.

history.title: A year in cells
history.text: Each cell is a day. In the app any day opens with everything you logged.
history.gridAria: Heatmap for the year. Use the arrow keys to move between days.

telegram.title: Log it in ten seconds
telegram.text: The bot is a quick way in for workouts, food, water and weight. Entries go to the same account you use on the website.
telegram.point1: Sign in with your connected Telegram — the bot never asks for a password.
telegram.point2: One workout per day: the bot and the website edit the same entry.
telegram.chatAria: Example: logging water with the NosiFit Telegram bot. The bot updates its message after a button is pressed.

model.title: Where recommendations come from
model.text: The training-load model is evidence-informed and heuristic. Some coefficients are engineering assumptions, and they are labelled as such.
model.note: It shows levels and states, not exact percentages. A hint for decisions, not a medical measurement.

cta.title: Start with one day
cta.text: A workout, a meal or a night of sleep — the dashboard fills in from the first entry.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: If you have a question, suggestion, or found a problem, send us a message.

demo.title: Demo
demo.description: See how the system works before creating an account.

about.title: About NosiFit
about.lead: Record your workouts, track recovery and see how your metrics change over time.

problem.title: Training does not happen in isolation.
problem.text: A workout is one part of your day. Sleep, nutrition, water and habits can change how that workload feels. NosiFit puts these records together so you can see the bigger picture without turning it into a game.

flow.title: From records to context
flow.text: NosiFit collects everyday data, compares it over time and turns it into a few practical signals.

what.title: The basics, in one place
what.text: The main areas NosiFit brings together for a clearer view of your routine.

score.title: Recovery Score
score.text: Recovery Score combines selected recovery signals into one number. It is a quick reference, not a medical measure or a replacement for your own judgment.
score.noteText: A score is useful when you look at the records behind it.

audience.title: Built for people who track their routine
audience.text: NosiFit is for people who want a simple place to record training and recovery data.
audience.data: A preference for seeing changes over time.

about.headline: Training is only one part of the picture.

footer.title: Start with the data you already have.
footer.text: Record a few things, use the dashboard, and build from there.

info.title: How NosiFit works
info.lead: A closer look at what you can record, how it is processed and where it appears in the app.

actions.title: What you can track
actions.lead: NosiFit focuses on a small set of records that are useful together.
actions.sleep: Sleep start and end times, including overnight sessions.
actions.habits: Regular actions that can affect recovery.
actions.recommendations: Short suggestions based on your recent records.

dataFlow.title: How the data is used
dataFlow.lead: The app turns individual records into a more useful overview.
dataFlow.dataText: Training, sleep, nutrition, water and habits are stored as separate pieces of your routine.
dataFlow.analysisText: Recent records are processed and compared with your previous data.
dataFlow.metricsText: The dashboard presents Recovery Score and other useful indicators.
dataFlow.recommendationsText: Suggestions use the available context rather than a single data point.

sections.title: Main areas
sections.lead: Each section has a specific role in the overall picture.
sections.dashboard: A quick overview of your current data.
sections.progress: Changes in your records over time.

purpose.title: The idea is simple
purpose.text: NosiFit is built to make your own data easier to read. Instead of keeping training and recovery records in separate places, you can view them together and decide what makes sense for your next day.
